metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the LAS 1.4 JSON inspector and renderer in [main.cpp](/workspace/output/main.cpp), with a standard-library-only C++20 build in [CMakeLists.txt](/workspace/output/CMakeLists.txt).

It handles point formats 0–10, VLRs and EVLRs, CRS records, Extra Bytes, waveform fields and opaque waveform payloads. It also checks header counts and bounds, record structure, and CRS and waveform consistency.

Build verified with `cd output && cmake -B build && cmake --build build`. The ESRI WKT dialect and per-packet waveform layout remain outside validation, as specified.
